He couldn't even imagine what he would say to the higher-ups in the company when Phainon wasn't present! Phainon was doomed. He might as well start finding a new job when they land. At least he packed his laptop so he can actually job hunt again while flying around the country for the tour. He inwardly sighed at the idea of job hunting once more. It already took him a couple of months to land this job; who knew how many more months he would need to search for another job?

“...Can I say some final words before you fire me?”

“What the fuck are you talking about?”

Phainon was still swiping the damp towel along Mydei’s bare body, but now in a much more dejected manner. He had moved on from his legs and was now at his torso, which was where most of his body was riddled with cum. He should probably rinse this towel. “Well… I just jumped my boss…”

“Said boss basically pulled you down to bed with him.”

Phainon pouted, his gaze still fixed upon Mydei's abdomen. “Yeah, but said subordinate fucked him six times.”

Mydei groaned, relaxing his body into the bed. “Don't remind me. My back already hurts.”

Not only did Phainon neglect his pilot duties and jump his boss within an hour of his first assignment, but he also injured the guy, the guy who also happened to be a high-profile star within the company. Yeah, Phainon was finished. He was sure headquarters didn't need any more excuses to fire him. “So can I say some final words before you fire me?”

“I'm not firing you, Phainon.”

“Really?!” Phainon's head shot up from where he had been focusing on wiping cum off his abdomen.

“You seriously thought I was going to fire you?” Mydei squinted in his direction. “Contrary to what you would do, I'm not going to voluntarily leave my dream man.”

Phainon pouted once more. "That's unfair. I just thought you didn't like me.”

The man lying in bed laughed. “So, what do you think now?”

“Um…” Phainon broke out into a cold sweat, his hands stilling once more as his gaze sank back down. Oh no. What was the right answer? Did Mydei like him? Plenty of people slept together without actually liking each other, right? Was Mydei the type of guy to do that, though? Phainon didn't think so, but he could also be totally, completely, and utterly wrong in that thinking. Wait.

“Dream man?!” Phainon's head shot up once more. “Me? You called me that?”

The rockstar rolled his eyes. “What a delayed reaction. Who else is in this room, HKS?”

Phainon actually had to resist the urge to check around the room again. “Just me.”

“That's right. So who is my dream man?”

“Just… me…”

Mydei chuckled. “That's a good boy.”

Phainon's ears burned red, but he continued focusing all of his attention on cleaning Mydei’s body as best as he could. He already grabbed another clean towel from the bathroom and had begun wiping down the rest of his torso. There was… too much to clean with just one towel unless he just wanted to keep pushing the cum and sweat around Mydei's body with a dirtied towel.

He couldn't believe Mydei was also calling Phainon his “dream man". It really felt like his ears weren't working today. Did they really feel about each other in the same way? It wasn't just a one-sided feeling? Mydei liked him? Was Mydei thinking of Phainon when they were apart too? How much did Mydei think of him? Every week? Every day? Every hour? Every second, even?

“So what were you doing at the club that day?” Mydei had already picked up his phone and was languidly scrolling through whatever he was looking at before dragging Phainon over to his room.

“I was celebrating graduating from pilot school.” Phainon smiled softly at the fond memory as he was ripped from his previously overly enthusiastic thoughts. “My friends took me out to dinner and the club.”

Mydei hummed without tearing his eyes from his phone. “You have quite a lot of friends.”

Phainon nodded in agreement. “One of my closest friends was my next-door neighbor growing up, but she doesn't really live nearby anymore. So I don't really see her anymore. Most of my other friends I met when I was an undergrad–” Phainon paused as his brain processed Mydei’s words, his hands still holding the damp towel. “Wait, how do you know that?”

It seemed that the man underneath his hands grew rigid, and he roughly managed, “You just seem like the type of guy to have a lot of friends.”

“Really?” Phainon raised an eyebrow. He never really thought about that before.

“You're quite the… caring and friendly type of guy. I would be surprised if you didn't have a lot of friends.”

Phainon felt like Mydei was hiding something from him, but he couldn't deny that the compliment made his heart full. “Mydei, I love you too!” He jumped into Mydei’s arms with a grin, with the man grunting from the weight that was suddenly being pressed down onto him.

“How did that equate to me confessing my love to you?!” Mydei shouted, trying to tear himself away from Phainon's limbs.

“I love you, Mydei! I love you!”

He was still holding that towel as he tightly wrapped his arms around Mydei’s torso. Thankfully, he had already wiped off a majority of the cum and sweat that was on his body, so he had no qualms with sticking himself to Mydei like glue and burying his face into Mydei’s hair, chanting his love for the rockstar.

The man seemed to sigh in defeat, his body growing limp in Phainon's grasp. “You went from trying to leave me alone to confessing to me all in a span of an hour.”

“I don't know what you're talking about,” Phainon adamantly denied, rubbing his nose along the shell of Mydei’s ear.

“You better not be seeing anyone else.”

“Only you, Mydei! Only you!”

A hand buried itself into Phainon's hair and began massaging his scalp. And so they lay together in the dirtied bed just like that, with Phainon grinning into Mydei’s ear, and Mydei running his fingers through Phainon's silver hair. But, although Phainon had adamantly confessed his love and didn't get rejected, he still wanted to hear it come straight from Mydei’s mouth too. Even if they just slept together, were cuddling together after sex, and were calling each other their “dream man”, Phainon still wanted to hear those exact words.

“Do you like me, Mydei?”

“What kind of question is that?”

“I want to hear it with my own ears.”

A silence pierced the air, but the hand in his hair never ceased its ministrations. “I like you, Phainon,” Mydei’s voice vibrated against Phainon's ear. “Didn't I call you my dream man already?”

Phainon blushed, his smile never ceasing. “I really like you too, Mydei.” It was then that an idea popped into his head. It was just the next step after confessing their feelings, right? “Are we allowed to date? Am I allowed to date a rockstar?”

“Why wouldn't you be able to?” Mydei furrowed his eyebrows at the question.

“I just didn't know if you had any sort of rules like that.” Phainon couldn't even begin to imagine how difficult it was having every single part of your life being scrutinized by millions of eyes.

Mydei scoffed. “I wouldn't have signed the contract with my current company otherwise if there was a clause like that.” He shifted in Phainon's arms, turning onto his side and burying Phainon's face into his chest. “If you don't call me your boyfriend, I will be pissed.”

“Yes, Mydei!” Phainon laughed. How many people were going to believe he was dating a rockstar? His childhood friend, Cyrene, was going to throw a fit. Even he still couldn't believe that this man, who was currently in his arms, was a well-renowned rockstar with millions of fans. No matter how many times he had watched his music videos and streamed his songs, Phainon still couldn't believe that Mydeimos was now his boyfriend.

“So why were you at the club that day?” Phainon asked, pushing his face into the soft skin of Mydei’s chest. Mydei’s earlier question to him only made Phainon all the more curious. “You were definitely alone that day. Why were you at the club by yourself?”

Since his face was buried into Mydei’s chest, he could feel a deep breath escape from his lungs. Phainon tried to glance upwards, but he couldn't really see from the angle he was at and how tightly Mydei was holding onto him.

“It's a long story.” Mydei’s voice vibrated against him. “How much do you know about Mydeimos?”

Phainon furrowed his eyebrows, leaning into Mydei’s embrace. “He's a world-renowned rockstar who plays the guitar. Leader of a band with a really good voice and a really good face.”

Mydei scoffed at the ending. “Have you been looking me up at all after we met?”

“Um…” Phainon hid his blush into Mydei’s chest, mumbling into his skin. “Maybe. But once I stopped going to the club, I stopped trying to look for you.”

The man in his arms hummed. “I went to the club that day to forget my name.”

Phainon instinctively tightened his arms around the man with a frown. Who would dare hurt his Mydeimos?

Mydei continued. “I had a falling out with my band.” His fingers sifted through silver hair. “We had a disagreement on the direction the band was going in, so I left.”

“So, this tour you're going on–”

"It's just for me.” Mydei let out another breath. “This is the tour for my solo debut.”

Phainon stayed silent as his story digested in his mind. It made sense why only Mydei was in this private jet and not the rest of the band. He didn't really question it much before, as most of his brain was too busy trying to deal with the fact that he was meeting Mydei again after so many months apart, and the other part of his brain was driving the plane. He had no idea Mydei was going through so much when he took a sip of his vodka pomegranate cocktail that night. Was Mydei using Phainon to forget his name too, like he wanted to do?

“Did you know your bandmates well?” Phainon asked another question. He didn't watch too many interviews of the whole band to really know, and many bands actually didn't get along with each other behind the cameras.

It was then that Mydei let out a shaky breath, and Phainon realized that it was a sensitive topic.

He quickly scrambled. “Mydei, you don't have to–”

“I knew them almost my whole life.” The hand in Phainon's hair stilled. “We made the band together and wrote songs together while we were still in school. We… didn't mean to become famous at all.”

Phainon couldn't even imagine the things Mydei had gone through. Banding together with his best friends, performing and writing songs just for fun, and ending up on a grand stage filled with millions of fans, only to leave those same people who saw everything right at your side for years. If Phainon were Mydei, he also would've wanted to forget his own name just for one night.

“I'm sorry, Mydei.”

“Why are you apologizing?” Mydei chuckled lowly, and the hand in Phainon's hair began its ministrations.

“I just… can't imagine having to leave your friends.” Phainon’s eyes searched in front of him, but his face was still being squished into Mydei’s chest. “Do you still talk to them at all?”

“Not really,” Mydei admitted. “But I would like to think we are still on good terms. I definitely… don't talk to my ex-boyfriend anymore.”

Phainon's eyes shot wide open. His what?!

He swallowed thickly, trying hard to act nonchalantly, but he couldn't stop the feeling of his heart clenching in his chest. Phainon just really hoped his voice wasn't shaking when he hesitantly opened his mouth. “Who was your boyfriend in the band?”

“Hephaestion, the drummer. I think he deserves someone better than me who won't do whatever the Hell he wants now.”

Phainon's arms instinctively tightened around Mydei once again. “I don't know what you're talking about. You're perfect, Mydei.”

The man's chest rumbled in laughter, but now Phainon’s mind could only think of one thing.

Who was Hephaestion? Phainon wasn't really looking at anyone else in the band interviews except for Mydei. Did they break up because of the falling out with the band? Or was it something else entirely? Would they still be together if the band were together? How often did Mydei still think about that guy? Did he miss him? Were there things that still reminded him of his ex? Mydei still definitely thought about his band a lot, and it was clear that he missed them. Did that include his ex too?

Did Mydei go to the club to forget about him?

His heart dropped into his stomach at the thought. Was Phainon just a rebound? Mydei said he was going to ask Phainon to go home with him that day, right? Was it just to forget about this guy? How alike was Phainon to his ex? Did he resemble him at all? Did Mydei even see Phainon for Phainon, or was Mydei seeing someone else entirely?

“I should…” Phainon untangled his arms from the other man, who raised an eyebrow. “I should probably get back to the cockpit. Who knows how long I left Herklas out there?” He let out a laugh, running a hand through his hair. Did he sound natural at all? Was his voice shaking? Were his hands shaking? Phainon couldn't feel anything at all, but he just hoped that Mydei would let him go.

Mydei scoffed, a smile on his face. “Go. And give my apologies to Herklas for pulling you away for so long.”

With a nod, Phainon stumbled out of the room, closing the door behind him. He was sure Krateros was staring right through him, but Phainon couldn't lift his gaze off the floor.

Who was Hephaestion?

He darted back to the cockpit, slamming himself right back down into the chair and earning himself a raised eyebrow from the other pilot. Ignoring the inquisitive stare, Phainon whipped out his phone to pull up the fastest search engine he could get his hands on. But he didn't get very far, as his body was thrust forward when two hands slammed on the back of his seat.

“Phainon! You sure had a fun time in there. I'm assuming you guys made up? Or was that break-up sex I was hearing in there? You should've seen the look on Krateros’s face!”

Phainon didn't have the space in his mind to even feel embarrassed at all, and his silence left both the newly-entered flight attendant and the other pilot confused. They exchanged a glance with each other before Empousa turned back to Phainon.

“Hello, Phainon? Did you even hear me at all?”

“Hi, Empousa,” were the only words that came out of Phainon's mouth. His fingers were too busy typing the name “Hephaestion The Detachment” into the search bar.

“Hi, Phainon,” Empousa huffed. She crossed her arms impatiently at the man's lack of response. “What are you doing?”

“Sorry?” He could barely even hear what the woman was saying.

She frowned. “What–are–you–doing?”

Before Phainon could even respond, the phone was snatched right out of his hand. He instinctively shot his hand out to try and grab it, but Empousa had already settled by Herklas's side while he watched her scroll through Phainon's phone.

“Hephaestion?” Empousa squinted at the phone screen. “Why are you looking him up?”

Phainon, who still had his hand raised in the air from trying to reach his phone, froze in place. “I don't know what you're talking about.”

“Phainon, we are literally staring at your phone.”

A blush slowly crept onto his face. Wow, was Phainon really caught trying to look up his boyfriend's ex? He was caught before he could actually find anything!

He laughed awkwardly, snatching his raised hand back to his side. “I was just… uh… curious about his past bandmates… is all…”

“And you started with his ex?”

Phainon could not answer that question.

With a heavy sigh, Empousa tossed the phone back into Phainon's lap. “Was there something you wanted to know about him? Something you can't even ask the man you just had screaming in the back?”

“Okay, can you not word it like that?!” Phainon's face was now fully a bright, crimson red, and Empousa doubled over in laughter, slapping Herklas on the way down as she attempted to grab something to keep her from falling to the floor. Which didn't work, by the way; the woman was already on her knees, clutching her stomach and wheezing for laughter.

“That's–That's the Phainon I know!” She managed words in between her full-on howling.

“Wait, did everyone hear us?” Phainon's gaze flitted between Herklas and Empousa, where one man silently stared right back at the sky ahead of them, and the other was still on her knees, wiping tears from her eyes.

Grasping for breath, Empousa shakily pushed herself from the floor using Herklas’s shoulder. “You… How big do you think this plane is? You can see the entirety of the plane just from standing in the middle.”

Phainon turned in his chair to face the sky, burying his burning face in his hands. “Okay, can we just pretend the last few minutes didn't exist?”

“You guys were going at it for way longer than a few minutes.”

“Can we forget the past hour then?!”

Empousa howled in laughter once more, slapping Herklas's shoulder as if he had just told the greatest joke her ears had ever heard, even though he hadn't opened his mouth once since Empousa had stepped into the cockpit.

“So.” Empousa loudly cleared her throat and started brushing her fingertips along the corners of her eyes, blinking the tears away. “Why are you looking up Hephaestion? Did Mydei say something about him?”

“He didn't really say anything.” Phainon's voice was muffled in his hands. “That's why I'm looking him up.”

“I'm sure Mydei would answer any questions you have about him.”

Phainon silently shook his head. What would that make Phainon if he straight-up asked Mydei questions about his past relationship? Jealous? Possessive? Phainon didn't want to mess up what he had with Mydei five minutes into their relationship.

A sigh came from the flight attendant. “I'll tell you right now; I'm positive Mydei likes you more than Hephaestion, if that's what you're concerned about.”

“You don't know that.”

“I do know that.”

“No, you don't.”

“I'm the flight attendant for their band too, and I can confidently say they have never had sex on the plane before.”

Phainon fell silent.

Empousa lightly punched Herklas's shoulder and hissed, “Say something!”

Herklas let out a deep breath, turning to Phainon, who still had his face buried in his hands. “What are you so concerned about?”

The question sank in Phainon's mind. What was he worried about? Was he worried about everything regarding Hephaestion and Mydei? Was it just killing him that he knew nothing about their past relationship? Or was it that Phainon wasn't sure if Hephaestion still lingered in his mind while he was with Phainon? They must've… been together a long time, right? Especially since Mydei said they had known each other since they were in school.

“Everything,” Phainon eventually mumbled.

“Let's start with something concrete.” Herklas shifted in his chair, relaxing his back into the seat and crossing his arms. “Ask a question.”

“How close were they?”

Empousa and Herklas fell silent.

“They–They're not close anymore!” Empousa started waving her arms in the air as she rushed to Phainon's side. “They don't talk anymore! Hephaestion told me himself!”

That still didn't really make Phainon feel much better.

“They were close back in the day,” Herklas admitted, and Empousa punched him in the shoulder once more.

“Why would you say that?!”

“You could tell just from looking at them. Anyone could tell those two were the closest out of everyone in the band,” Herklas continued, but Empousa looked ready to just choke the guy out. Swatting her feisty hands away, Herklas kept talking. “So it is also equally as obvious to see that Mydei doesn't think about him anymore.”

“How do you know that?” Phainon mumbled into his palms.

“Because Mydei isn't the type of person to linger on one person while having thoughts for another person.” Herklas was confident in his words. “If anything, Mydei would call you a dumbass for even having these sorts of thoughts.”

“Herklas!”

He ignored Empousa. “Mydei is the type of person to know what he wants, and he will do exactly that. If he still wanted Hephaestion or even thought about him at all, he wouldn't be with you.”

That last sentence really settled with Phainon. He was right; although there was more to Mydei that Phainon didn't know of, what he did know was that Mydei was a straightforward man who didn't overcomplicate himself or his feelings. If he liked one person, he was going to stay with that person, and if he needed to move on from one person, he would. He was just that sort of man who knew what he wanted, whether it came to himself or to the people around him, and he was never one to second-guess or overthink. It was a trait that Phainon was envious of, as someone who was constantly overthinking things and berating himself over those thoughts–like right now.

“You're right.” A sigh escaped Phainon's chest as he finally parted ways with the palms of his hands. “He is that type of guy.”

Empousa beamed and whipped her head toward Herklas. “You did it!”

“Despite your mumbling and grumbling.” Herklas rolled his eyes, and that earned him another punch.

“Was there…” Phainon grunted. There was still one other thing that kept rapping on his mind. “Was there anything similar between me and him? Does Mydei… see him in me?”

“No,” Herklas immediately answered. “Even if you two are similar, Mydei sees you as two separate people.”

“What similarities are there?”

Herklas sighed loudly; that was probably the most emotion he had shown this entire flight. “Why do you want to know that?”

“I'm just curious!”

“The curiosity will kill you.”

“And it will, if I don't know!” Phainon wailed, dropping his shoulders. “Just please answer me this question?”

Another sigh from his co-pilot, resigning to his fate. “You're both whiny.”

“Whiny?!”

“Were you not just whining for me to answer your question?”

Phainon could not answer that question.

At his silence, Herklas droned on. “Whiny, constantly teasing Mydei, always hiding things from him, loud.”

“I'm not–!”

At the looks both Herklas and Empousa gave him, Phainon fell silent. Was that really how people saw him? He literally just met these two about two hours ago.

“You're both very… How should I put this?” Empousa frowned, jumping into the conversation. “The life of the party? You both attract people's attention and draw crowds. Is charismatic the word for that? And you both pull Mydei into things or situations he would never dream of even doing, but he still has fun doing those things.”

It was Phainon's turn to frown. “When have I ever done that?”

“When you pulled him into the mile-high club.”

“Again, can we stop mentioning what happened an hour ago?! And wait, Mydei started it! ”

Empousa laughed once more at Phainon's burning face, and she quickly cleared her throat. “Okay, okay, anything else on your mind?”

“Is there… anything different between us?” At the words of the other two, they just sounded like the exact same person. Phainon wasn't sure if he exactly liked that now that he was dating Mydei.

“For one, you're definitely more built than him,” Herklas immediately answered. “Hephaestion is skinny.”

“Yeah, Phainon, you're huge!”

Phainon's face bloomed red once more. “Okay, thanks, guys,” he stiffly replied. “Anything else?”

“You seem more like a mess than Hephaestion.”

His mouth dropped open. Was that an insult? “What does that mean?”

Phainon was surprised to see Herklas laughing at him after his statement, but he didn't bother explaining what he meant. Somehow, Empousa was nodding right beside Herklas, and Phainon turned with pleading eyes over to her, silently begging for her to explain.

“Phainon, you're like… really chaotic to be around.”

“What does that mean?!”

Phainon couldn't possibly fathom what they were talking about. He had always thought of himself as a pillar, or at least, a reliable figure to be around–someone who others could depend upon. Did he have the wrong impression about himself this entire time?

But Empousa seemed to confirm his thoughts about himself: “You're very reliable and dependable, Phainon, but you also have a lot going on at the same time. Your mind seems to be filled with a lot of things all at once.”

“Wrong,” Herklas immediately butted in. “He only thinks of Mydei. What I meant by ‘mess’ was that you are very expressive. I think Hephaestion just laughs off most of his problems, but you seem to think a little too hard about your problems.”

“Okay, but I think he thinks about a lot of things at once!” Empousa retorted. “Sure, they're all about Mydei at the end of the day, but it's a lot of different things about Mydei.”

“Guys, I don't just think about Mydei.” Phainon received two very dubious stares, and he looked around at the two of them exasperatedly. “I don't just think about Mydei… Right?”

“Anything else you want to ask?” Empousa immediately moved on from the question with a too-pleasant smile across her lips.

Why did Phainon feel like he was just getting berated the entire conversation?

He frowned, trying to think if there was anything else he wanted to ask, but after the extreme roasting session he just received from two coworkers whom he literally just met, he wasn't sure if he wanted to ask anything more.

“Do you think… I'm a rebound?” Phainon hesitately glanced up at the two of them, but none of their expressions seemed to change in response to his question.

“Phainon…” Empousa furrowed her eyebrows. “Are you serious?”

“It's a genuine question!”

“Definitely, definitely not,” Empousa sternly replied. She approached Phainon's side, landing a hand upon his slumped shoulder. “Mydei isn't that type of person. We told you, didn't we? He's a straightforward type of guy. And it's been a few months now; I'm sure Mydei was over that guy a long, long time ago.”

“Still…” Phainon's eyes were downcast at their feet, and his eyes trailed over how pristine everyone's leather shoes were. “Is there the slightest chance he could be using me to forget about Hephaestion? They must've been together for, what? For years? There's no way he could get over his first love that quickly, right?” He still couldn't get over the fact that Mydei had said he went to the club that day to forget his name, and it also didn't settle well in Phainon’s mind that he would never be Mydei’s first. Did he see Phainon there and think that it was a good opportunity to forget about his ex-boyfriend too?

“Not even the slightest,” Empousa answered. “I promise you, Mydei really likes you.”

“But you've only ever seen him yelling at me.”

“Yeah, but I also heard you guys going at it for the past hour.”

Phainon really felt like he was going through tribulations in this conversation.

“If you're really worried, then just ask Mydei yourself.” Empousa grinned. “Mydei would have no problem answering any of your questions.”

With a heavy sigh, he unlocked his phone and exited the search results about Hephaestion, earning cheers and claps from Empousa next to him. There was no point in thinking in circles, and Empousa was right; if he really couldn't stop thinking about Hephaestion, he should just go to Mydei himself for answers, even if it made him look like a crazy, possessive maniac.

Empousa exited the cockpit, mumbling about now having to clean Mydei's room, and Phainon was left in the cockpit with Herklas and his own swirling thoughts. He sat back in his seat, watching the clouds below them in silence. They still had about a few hours left before they landed at their first destination, and Phainon wasn't sure how he was going to last with all of these deprecating thoughts in his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Phainon
chapters.html:
A heavy sigh left Phainon's chest once the private jet was finally still. They had just landed at the airport at their destination and pulled into a private hangar to stop the plane. Of course, the company was wealthy enough to rent out a private hangar; why was Phainon even surprised at this point?

Phainon and Herklas were parking the plane, while Empousa conducted last-minute checks inside the jet, ensuring everything was clean and in order. Phainon offered to help her clean Mydei's room for… certain reasons, but she denied and told him to just focus on flying the plane like he was supposed to be doing. Krateros had already called a chauffeur to drive them from the parked plane to the airport, where they could be on their way to their hotel.

Taking their suitcases and exiting the plane, Phainon was about ready to crash for the day–him, not the plane. He was exhausted, and he was just about ready to stretch and lie down in a nice, plush hotel bed. There were a total of five people, and Phainon wasn't sure if he would be sharing a room with Herklas or not. Then again, he probably wouldn't have been surprised if the company could afford to give every single person their own hotel room. Though he didn't mind sharing a room with Herklas, since the man was quiet and kept to himself most of the time. Phainon forgot the guy was even with him in the cockpit for a majority of the flight.

They climbed into the black minivan that had pulled up at their hangar, with the chauffeur helping to stack their bags into the car. Phainon felt his body slump in the seat upon hearing all the car doors close; it wasn't as if he wasn't relaxed on the plane or anything, but now he could stop thinking about work for the next three days.

According to the schedule, Mydei was performing tomorrow night and the night after that, and he had one rest day for himself once those two concerts were finished. They would fly to their next destination at the end of their third day here. That also meant Phainon could do whatever he wanted for the next three days. Well, two and a half days, if he didn't count having to prepare for their next flight. But Phainon wasn't going to think about that right now. He was way too tired to continue thinking about work.

It wasn't as if Phainon hated his job; he went to pilot school for a reason, after all. Phainon absolutely loved his job. Being able to travel to new places, meet new people, and experience different sights and cultures was something that he could never tire of. Even just being able to soar through the clouds and take in the vast sky in front of him was a view that Phainon lived to see, and if it wasn't for this profession, he wouldn't even be sitting next to his boyfriend in this car either.

Venturing through the airport and climbing into a black van with tinted windows, Phainon watched the streets pass by before him as they made their way to the hotel, which was quite the luxury hotel that was a little way from the concert venue where Mydei would be performing. As this was a major city within the country, Phainon had flown to this destination before, but he still enjoyed watching the nightlife play before his eyes as they traveled through the streets.

Exiting the van and entering the hotel, it seemed that Krateros was quite the busy man, who checked them in and met up with the rest of the staff who traveled in a separate commercial airliner. Even though it was the evening when they landed, he was still finalizing the logistics for the concert tomorrow, and from what Phainon could hear from where he was standing, he was talking about everything with their team: hair, makeup, costuming, and stage positioning and lighting, despite being nowhere near the stage.

Room 550 was written in the key.

No, no, no, that was impossible. They booked these rooms even before Phainon's first day. There was no possible way they had planned to make their rockstar share a room with the pilot. Did they change the rooms when they got here? That was unlikely too, unless they paid hundreds of dollars to change their booking at the last minute. Mydei immediately scowled. “A salad?”

Sighing exasperatedly, Mydei picked up the phone to dial room service.

After grabbing the food from the hotel staff, Phainon thanked them and shut the door, approaching Mydei with their food. The rockstar was sitting on the edge of his bed and tuning his guitar. “It’s a Fender guitar,” Mydei answered without glancing up from his guitar. He was fiddling with the ends of his guitar, strumming it with his other hand to ensure it sounded right to his ears for the concert tomorrow. Mydei previously explained to him that guitars could go out of tune during flights when he unpacked his guitar right after his shower.

Phainon settled on the floor at Mydei’s feet, separating their food and setting his portion next to him. “A Fender guitar? How much is it?”

Phainon slowly returned to eating his food. He couldn’t believe he was just getting to attend a concert for free. To watch his own boyfriend perform at his own concert. He already looked perfect in the concert clips Phainon had seen before; he couldn’t even begin to imagine what it was like to actually watch Mydei perform right in front of him.

Mydei hummed. “The concert starts at 8 PM. Come a little before then. I don’t want you to see the rehearsal just yet. I want you to experience the concert first.” He began digging into his own food, lavishing in the sweet flavor. “You can come to the next rehearsal.”

With a small smile and an enthusiastic nod, Phainon finished the rest of his food in a contented silence. They had opened the balcony door earlier, and a cool breeze would sweep into the room every now and then. They were still in the city but were far enough away to not be disturbed by the hustle and bustle of the downtown area, so they had quite a breathtaking view of the city skyline in tranquility. While washing his hands after throwing away his trash, a voice came from the sleeping area.

“Phainon, you’re sleeping in the same bed as me tonight.”

It was not going to be a peaceful night for Phainon.

Blearily blinking the sleep out of his eyes, he looked around the room, which was dimly lit due to the curtains that were still closed, giving the whole room a gentle glow. Mydei had already left for rehearsal in the morning, which left Phainon alone for the day until it was time for the concert.

It was then that he realized he had never told his friends that the client he was flying for really was Mydeimos, the rockstar. He was so in shock over seeing that it was actually Mydei that he had forgotten to message them before the plane took off, and he obviously didn't have service while in the air. And when they landed, well, by this point, he was too preoccupied with Mydei himself. He messaged them all back, letting them know the flight was fine and he was just resting in the hotel for now. Well, they'll find out eventually when they return a couple of months from now. He already received the flight schedule beforehand, so his friends already knew he would be out for work for a while.

The rest of his day, leading up to the concert, was quite peaceful. He called Aglaea to help him put a nice outfit together, which mostly consisted of just her berating most of the clothing options he decided to pack. Phainon also dined at one of the hotel restaurants for lunch, and it was still crazy to him that a restaurant was part of the hotel. He had never experienced a five-star hotel before, and it was overwhelming to him at how many amenities were included. With his spare time, he went out and explored the city, running into many Mydeimos fans who were excitedly awaiting the concert. He could tell from all the rock T-shirts and merchandise, and it made his heart full seeing Mydei so loved.

About an hour before the concert, the front desk of the hotel arranged a car for him that would take him to the concert venue. Phainon was quite literally fiddling with his phone in the middle of calling for a car in the lobby when one of the staff ran up to him and informed him they could take Phainon instead. He was baffled; he didn't realize car services were a part of fancy hotels either, but he happily accepted and was on his way. Someone really needed to tell Phainon everything that was included in typical five-star hotels so that he could take advantage of all their amenities and services, because his humble upbringing could not begin to fathom what could be included.

And then it was time. When he climbed out of the car, he was overwhelmed by the sheer crowd that was already waiting for Mydeimos outside. Phainon didn't actually know where he was supposed to go; Mydei just told him that Krateros would take care of everything, so it was just up to Phainon to reach out to someone to take him backstage.

He reached for his phone in his pocket, and the truth suddenly hit him: he still didn't have Mydei's number! They had basically been together the entire time, so there was no need to exchange numbers! Phainon seriously could not believe that wasn't the first thing they did after they made up. Wait, the first thing they did was sleep together; no wonder they still didn't have each other's numbers.

Phainon, in a panic, dug through the list of recently called phone numbers until he found the date when he was offered a job by Kremnos Entertainment. Dialing the number, he just really hoped it was Krateros's actual cell phone and not a desk phone he had at headquarters. His other worry was that Krateros didn't save his number, and he may not pick up a phone call from a random number while he was busy trying to finalize the last few details for the concert.

The call was immediately picked up. “Phainon?”

Thank God Krateros saved Phainon's number!

“Hey, I'm here, but I don't know where to go.”

A grunt sounded from the other line. “Find someone with a Mydeimos staff shirt. They will bring you back; just tell them you know my name.”

The call was hung up, leaving Phainon to his own devices. Why were his phone calls with Krateros always exactly two seconds long?

Weaving through the excited crowd to try and locate a single staff member, he could hear all the conversations surrounding Mydeimos. People were talking about his new album, his new debut, where he was going to take this new career, his old band, and how hot he looked in the new music video. Phainon frowned at that; he agreed for sure, but he didn't want other people to agree. Some of them were even talking about how they hoped Mydeimos would rip his shirt off for this concert! Did that imply he has done it before?! He made a mental note to confront Mydei about that later.

Different lines were waiting for different things, and Phainon quickly approached the staff who were selling merchandise. Waving apologetically to the person who was in the middle of telling the staff what they wanted to buy, Phainon quickly blurted out his question.

“Can you help bring me to Krateros?”

The staff member appeared slightly shocked at his question, but they relaxed just as quickly. “What's your name?”

“Phainon.”

The staff member nodded and produced a walkie-talkie in their hand, muttering something into the receiver. It wasn't long before the staff nodded in Phainon's direction before turning back to the fan that was still trying to buy from them. Phainon wasn't sure if he was supposed to just stand here and wait, but as he was trying to figure out if he should go somewhere else, that was out of the way of the merchandise line, Krateros appeared himself.

“Krateros?” Phainon did not think the manager was going to personally get him.

It seemed the manager also didn't think so either, as he clicked his tongue in annoyance. “I have so many things to do, yet that bastard still wants me to come get you myself.”

With a laugh, Phainon hurriedly followed Krateros backstage. It seemed that many of the fans even recognized Krateros as Mydeimos’s manager, as he started hearing whispers and murmurs about who Phainon was and why he was being personally escorted by Mydeimos’s manager as they passed by crowds of fans. Some of them even pulled out their phones to take pictures of the two of them as they scurried backstage.

It was only a couple of minutes now before the concert was starting, and he could see that the waiting crowd was finally allowed into the venue as they went to their assigned seating. Krateros just wildly waved his hand at some part near the front of the stage before leaving Phainon, but thankfully, he made eye contact with Herklas and Empousa, who were sitting near the staff at the side of the stage.

“Phainon!” Empousa exclaimed as he settled near them. “Nice of you to join us today.”

“Have you guys been here all day?” Phainon took in the chanting crowd, the full seats, and the grand stage before them. Phainon still couldn't believe he had somehow gotten wrapped up with the man they were all waiting to see.

Empousa nodded. “We usually come just to hang out and give an extra hand when the staff need one, but Mydei told us he wanted you to see the concert first.”

Phainon laughed, but before he could say anything, screams pierced the air as the venue lighting began to dim. Everyone, including Phainon, turned their attention toward the stage. With wide eyes and a pounding heart, a loud strum of an electric guitar reverberated through his entire body, overtaking even his own heartbeat and echoing through the venue. Cheers and cries from the fans sitting behind him followed shortly behind as the scene began to play out right in front of his very eyes.

The concert had begun.

Phainon has been to a concert before. He’s been to many concerts before. But this concert was something Phainon could’ve never imagined.

The moment the concert started with that strum of his guitar echoing throughout the venue, Phainon waited anxiously with bated breath, sitting at the edge of his seat. His heart was pounding in his ears as if he were the one about to perform in front of a crowd of thousands, but nothing would ever beat the sight of Mydeimos finally being revealed to everyone in that venue that night. With his trusty black guitar hanging from his shoulders, the show was about to begin.

The chanting crowd, the pounding of the drums that rattled his ribcage. The blaring, flashing lights, and the strums of guitars that vibrated in his brain. The raw emotion and power that echoed from the stage was unlike anything Phainon had ever experienced before, as everything in that entire venue centered around one specific golden-haired man. Everything was perfect, from the stage lighting to the positioning of the backup band that played the instrumentals to the main character himself, who could be found no matter where one’s eyes flickered amongst the stage.

It was something that didn’t compare to watching the concert clips on his phone screen all those months ago. He couldn’t feel the music physically hitting his body in waves, thrumming against his eardrums. He couldn’t experience the goosebumps that rose on his skin with every powerful vocal that resounded from the stage. He couldn’t feel the energy of the crowd, chanting the lyrics to every song along with the man who engaged with the crowd, calling for them and returning their energy tenfold.

Phainon could tell it was hot on that stage with how brightly the lights were shining down on everything and everyone below, and he was so close to the stage that he could see the sweat dripping down his body in rivulets. But despite all of that, Mydeimos was still running around the stage and shining even by himself, with that stupidly handsome smirk and his stupidly gorgeous golden hair. He learned from the crowds chanting and screaming that they call him “King Mydeimos,” or just “King” for short, and he didn’t doubt it with the way the man basically commanded everyone’s attention, commanded everyone on stage, and commanded the whole show himself under his leering, sharp gaze and his dominating vocals.

It didn’t even feel like this man, who had thousands of eyes watching him shred his guitar that Phainon was too afraid of getting salad dressing on, was the same man who hated the taste of whiskey so much that he called a stranger out for it. Mydeimos was a man who belonged on stage, and it would have felt like a crime if he could never stand on stage again. Phainon understood just why Mydeimos had so many fans and so many pairs of eyes watching him. He also understood why those fans continued to support him even after leaving his own band. It wasn’t right to rip this glory and fame from Mydeimos’s hands, because this was right where he belonged, and the public knew it just as well as him, if not even better than Phainon.

Each and every song that echoed throughout the concert venue sounded better than Phainon could’ve ever imagined. He has heard his music and his singing many, many times on his phone and on streaming services, but Mydeimos sounded so much better in person than any microphone or studio equipment could capture. In fact, Phainon would argue that the recording studio was holding him back, because Phainon was convinced Mydeimos would have so many more fans if more people could hear him live.

His songs were so full of emotion and passion; Phainon could tell just from listening to his songs on his phone. But the feelings of every song were almost emphasized by the way the man performed in front of him, and that raw emotion was what the microphones and studio equipment could not capture. Anyone in this concert venue could just feel what Mydeimos was feeling, and every song resonated so deeply inside of Phainon that it hurt his chest and his brain. He had songs about longing, loss, sadness, and anger, and after the past few months of Mydeimos leaving his band and venturing on to a new path all by himself, it was as if he were taking everyone along with them and showing everyone exactly what he had gone through.

Even between intermissions, the crowd’s energy did not dissipate, as they chanted, yelled, and cried for the King, even with no one on stage. They stomped their feet against the floor, with the vibrations pounding in Phainon’s brain. And every time Mydeimos reappeared in a new stage outfit and hair, it was like the King was reborn again and again. It was a sight that Phainon never tired of, seeing his golden eyes sparkle upon facing the crowd once more, and his smile that was adored by millions of people. Phainon understood why he was such a beloved rockstar; no, this man was more like the Sun than just any other star, as if the whole world revolved around him for this night. Even with the actual sun well below the horizon, Mydeimos was glowing in his own radiance.

He had faintly heard Empousa asking him something at one point, most likely related to Mydeimos or the concert, but Phainon was too hypnotized by the stage and the man who commandeered it to even reply. Mydeimos was a sight to behold, and he couldn't tear his eyes away from this shining light even if Phainon tried. Mydei was beautiful, Phainon couldn't deny that fact, but he was absolutely flourishing on that stage. A confident smirk was flashed his way by none other than the main character of tonight when he had approached their side of the stage, and Phainon's face erupted in a flush of red. With a silent laugh and a cheeky smile from the performing man, Mydeimos continued with his perfect song and his perfect concert.

It was a perfect night for Phainon, up until his very last song.

There were no fancy lights or stage effects during this song. It was just Mydeimos, alone on that giant stage, when he had announced that this would be the last and final song of the night.

Boos echoed throughout the stands, much to Phainon's amusement, and the main character laughed at their reactions. “Haven't you seen enough of me? I've been the only one here for the past three hours.” The King smirked.

“Never!” One voice cried from the stands, earning laughs and praises from the other fans.

The King laughed along with their antics, shifting the guitar on his shoulders until he was holding it in his hands. “Then you'd better watch carefully. This song is very special to me, and I'm sure you all know it too.

Even though this song is not what I usually write, I hope you all still take the time to listen. Good night, everyone.”

It was then that the lyrics completely slammed into Phainon's head, so hard that it made his head and his heart pound.

Phainon had never actually specifically heard his newest album. Back when Phainon was still searching for the man, he would play Mydeimos's songs. But by the time his new album was released, Phainon had already stopped trying to contact the rockstar and completely abandoned all noise of the man. Because of that, Phainon heard many new songs during this concert, but this particular song, which Mydeimos specifically said meant a lot to him, struck Phainon in his core.

The slower song, which was so dramatic yet so beautifully sung, was a song that poured out deep passion and yearning. It was almost as if the singer were crying desperately for something or someone. It was a song that asked and begged for attention, not commanded it, and it was a song that sounded almost like a plea. Mydeimos was still for this song; he wasn't running around the stage like he was in his other songs, nor was he stripping his clothing like he was for the more excitable songs. The man was completely still in the center of the stage, putting his all into singing this song about someone that he strongly craved–someone that he wanted the attention of, and someone he wanted so desperately to remember him.

And Phainon knew the song wasn't about him.

Why would the song be about him? They literally reunited yesterday. If the song was part of his newest album, which dropped before he had met with Phainon, then it obviously was not about Phainon. No matter how much Phainon wanted it to be about him, the timeline didn't make any sense at all.

Who was the song about? Who was swirling in Mydei's mind as he wrote this song and poured everything into this song? Who was swirling in his mind right at this very moment? Mydeimos wasn't particularly looking at anyone; he was more preoccupied with pronouncing every word with the most love and passion Phainon had ever heard from any human being.

Mydeimos had specifically said he usually didn't write this type of song; then, what person had made Mydei feel so much that he had to write this type of song?

And why wasn't it Phainon?

The crowd was completely silent as they listened to this powerful, last song, waving their phone flashlights in the air to create a beautiful array of lights cascading throughout the stands. Mydeimos was surrounded by stars, and Phainon couldn't handle looking at the sun anymore. It was… much too bright for him now.

With the longest three to four minutes of his life coming to an end, the concert finally came to a close. The lights in the venue flashed on as the fans began filing out of the stands, murmuring about his great performance even without The Detachment. Phainon was left completely empty and still in his chair, feeling as if he weren't even in his own body anymore, to the point that he wasn't awakened until someone had tugged on his arm.

“Phainon?” Empousa covered the view of the stage that was in his sight, and he blinked blankly at the woman.

He managed a weak laugh, pushing himself to his feet. “Sorry, the concert was just…” He swallowed thickly. “Really good.”

“Right?!” Empousa enthusiastically nodded her head. “I could never get over his concerts! I wondered what he would be like without his bandmates, but I see now that he was still just as good as ever.”

Phainon nodded slightly. It felt like his head was pounding with the biggest migraine he had ever experienced, and he just wanted to go to sleep and forget he even existed for just a night. Why did Mydei have to end with that song? He was having such a good time until that song was performed.

The three of them returned to the hotel, as Mydei still had some work to finalize for the night and prepare for the concert tomorrow. Phainon barely registered Herklas calling for a car, he barely registered climbing into said car, and he barely registered willing his feet forward into the hotel until he was back in front of Room 550.

He stared at the door plate, wondering if he should even step inside in the first place. If he went into this room, it would be a guarantee that he would see Mydei again. Maybe he could fall asleep before he came back? That was easier said than done; Phainon's head was pounding, and his brain was too busy repeating every single lyric from that song. Why must he remember it so well?

Maybe there was a chance he could hang around with Empousa and Herklas. Maybe he could pretend that he was having such a fun and enjoyable night that he didn't want the night to end, so he didn't return to his room immediately. That sounded like a plausible reason for not going back, but there was no way he could avoid Mydei forever.

Phainon knew he wasn't Mydei’s first love, and it hurt him so much it was hard to breathe at the thought that continually seared his brain. Phainon couldn't rewind time to be Mydei's first love, and he couldn't change that at all. It was something that Phainon had to accept. No matter how much his head pounded, how much his heart clenched tightly in his chest, or how much his tears burned the corner of his eyes, it was a fact that Phainon had to accept.

Mydei was a beautiful man, and he couldn't be mad that someone else was also in love with him at one point in time. In fact, it wouldn't make any sense at all if someone as beautiful as him didn't have any previous lovers.

Phainon would have to accept that he wouldn't be Mydei's first in anything. He wasn't Mydei's first kiss, his first date, his first cuddle, or even his first time in bed. It was normal for people to have previous partners; his brain obviously knew that, but his heart didn't want to accept it at all.

Phainon was possessive. Sure, he's had short flings and relationships before when he was young and in school, but it was nothing compared to what he felt with Mydei. He had never felt this way before, and he didn't realize how possessive, jealous, and disgusting of a man he could become. He wanted to covet Mydei all to himself, but it was already too late for that.

Shaking his head and subsequently irritating his pounding head, Phainon decided to just turn around and go for a walk in the city. He'd rather take in the sights of the beautiful nighttime city while having these terrible thoughts instead of holing himself up in his room and waiting for the source of his awful emotions to return. He wanted to greet Mydei with a smile on his face. He wanted to kiss him all over and tell him how amazing and breathtaking his concert was. But right now, Phainon couldn't bring himself to even look at the color gold, and he didn't want to greet Mydei after his concert with these abhorrent thoughts eating their way into his very soul. It was clear that Mydei had a fantastic night, and he didn't want to ruin it for him.

With a deep breath, Phainon whirled around on his feet, strolling down the orderly corridor and back where he came from. He raised a hand to press the elevator button, and it almost didn't even feel like he was existing in his own body. Phainon truly felt like just an empty shell that was just existing in this space and in this time.

He stepped into the parted elevator doors with another deep breath, watching the floor numbers above his head slowly count down. He wasn't surprised in the slightest that the company had booked the top floor in the hotel since those were always the most expensive rooms. Phainon let out another weak chuckle. This company just had way too much money to itself.

The elevator chime woke him up once more, and he stepped out into the lobby. It was empty as it was quite late into the night now. There was probably nothing open in the city where he could go to forget about himself and his stubborn thoughts, but at least he wouldn't have to be in that room that he shared with Mydei. And that was all Phainon wanted right at this moment.

Once he was feeling better, he could act as that perfect, excited boyfriend for his rockstar. Once these negative feelings were left behind, Phainon could rave about how beautiful and lovely and perfect Mydei was standing on that stage. Phainon promised himself that he would praise the man all the way up to the moon for his performance, but that had to be at a later time.

The city was absolutely beautiful. Phainon had already walked through the streets during his spare time earlier that day, but it was quite the sight to behold at night. The stars twinkled above his head, and the silent tranquility was exactly what his pounding head needed. He almost just wanted to stay out here for the rest of the night, just him and by himself. Should he call one of his friends just to distract himself? Though he wasn't sure what they were doing, especially with the time difference with him being almost across the country, and he didn't want to disturb them.

Phainon decided to just stroll through the silent city by himself.

“Phainon?”

Mydei returned quite late to his hotel room after taking care of everything he needed to do after the concert, and he wasn't expecting Phainon to be awake or anything since it was 2 AM. However, Mydei didn't expect to return to an empty hotel room. A completely empty hotel room. Which wasn't possible at all, as he had specifically changed his room so that it wouldn't be empty. He was quite exhausted from the concert and had wanted to return to his room, take a shower, and fall asleep between two strong arms. But, the man of said arms was nowhere to be found.

“Phainon?” Mydei repeated again. He dropped his bags and guitar case to the floor, hesitantly stepping into the untouched hotel room. There wasn't a single sign that someone had returned; in fact, it looked almost like the hotel was being completely unused. Besides their suitcases, which were still open and strewn on the floor, Mydei would've thought that he had stepped into the wrong hotel room entirely.

The silence was permeating his brain as his footsteps echoed loudly in his ears. Mydei’s eyes scanned the room as his heartbeat began to quicken in the still hotel room.

“Phainon?”

Only silence continued to answer him, and he whirled on his feet to check the bathroom. But no one was there. Actually, the bathroom was completely untouched too, with not a single stray droplet of water to be found either in the bath or by the sink.

His heartbeat was ringing in his ears as his hands grew clammy. Mydei was about ready to collapse in bed exactly three seconds ago until the panic started to settle in his veins.

“Phainon!”

His panic-stricken mind made him check everywhere. And by everywhere, Mydei truly meant everywhere. Other than checking the bath and the standing shower, he checked both walk-in closets, ripped the sheets off both beds, got onto his knees to check under the bed, stepped out onto the balcony, and even tried checking each individual drawer of the dresser. As if a well-built, grown adult man could fit into a tiny dresser, but Mydei's panicking mind didn't care a single bit.

“Phai…non?”

Mydei was standing in the middle of a completely empty hotel room that now looked like a tornado had run through it, with no one still responding back to him. Where did he go? What was he doing? Why wasn't he here?

Where else could he go?

“Phainon?” Mydei's blurring vision was scanning the walls behind him as if they held some clue as to Phainon’s current location. His throat was tightening up, and his chest was rising and falling in ragged breaths.

Did he leave him again?

Not right after Mydei had finally reunited with him. Not after Mydei had finally sorted out their misunderstanding with him. Was Phainon really just going to leave him again, just like that?

Mydei rapidly shook his head despite his spiraling brain or his twisting heart. No, that was impossible. Phainon was still his pilot. Phainon couldn't just up and disappear, unless he wanted to get fired, and from Phainon's earlier actions of wanting to say his last words on the plane, it was clear that the man didn't want to lose his job.

Then, where the Hell was he?!

Taking deep breaths to remind himself that Phainon was still around, and that it was a very, very low chance that he really did just disappear and drop his job, his brain tried to rack for another solution. If he couldn't find Phainon, then could he just contact him?

Mydei sank his hand into his pocket, and upon feeling his phone in his fingers, he immediately grew rigid at the realization.

How did he still not have that bastard’s number?!

With his panic quickly turning into exasperated anger, his fuming brain thought of another plausible solution. His only option now was to run to Empousa and Herklas for answers. Weren't they sitting with him during the concert? Mydei clearly locked eyes with Phainon during the concert, and he saw that he was sitting with them. Then they had to have returned together, right? Unless Phainon decided to go elsewhere after the concert? But what the fuck would be open after 2 AM?

Mydei dashed out of his room and hurriedly banged on both of their hotel doors, almost knocking them off their hinges, in the depths of the night, to ask if they knew where Phainon was. Both of them, who were in the middle of sleeping, could not answer his question, as their last memory of Phainon was when they all returned to their hotel together immediately following the concert.

“Where the fuck is he?!”

“Mydei, calm down! We'll find him!”

Unfortunately, neither Empousa nor Herklas knew where Phainon was, and neither of the two had his phone number either. They were all now crowded in Mydei's room while the man panic-called Krateros, who wasn't picking up his phone. Herklas had the bright idea to ask Krateros if he had Phainon's phone number, since he had hired Phainon in the first place, but now his damn manager wasn't answering his phone. Mydei had already gone to angrily punch his door, but he could faintly hear water running. They were now impatiently waiting for Krateros to finish his shower.

“Does anyone have this man's damn number?!” Mydei couldn't sit still and was pacing back and forth, with Empousa trying desperately to calm the man.

“Krateros must have it since he hired him! Once he answers, we'll be able to call Phainon. So please just sit still, Mydei.” Empousa and Herklas were trailing the man with worried eyes as he continually paced up and down the room. While Mydei was panicking to himself, Empousa and Herklas took the liberty of straightening the hotel room, setting the sheets and pillows back onto the two beds where they belonged.

“Why isn't he picking up his damn phone?!” Mydei wanted to tear his hair out of his own scalp. Mydei and Krateros had returned to the hotel together but had parted ways since they resided in different hotel rooms. Mydei literally just saw his manager, so why wasn't he picking up his phone?!

Empousa hesitantly opened her mouth. “I guess he's still showering?”

“What kind of fuck ass shower takes this long?!” Mydei groaned and ran a furious hand through his hair. The one person who had the slightest chance of having this stupid bastard’s phone number just had to be currently unreachable. Absolutely zero sanity was left in Mydei's brain, and no matter Empousa’s sound words, it didn't calm Mydei down in the slightest. In fact, it only made him even angrier. What kind of evil stars aligned that made both his pilot and his manager unreachable at the same time?! And why did Mydei not exchange numbers with Phainon earlier when their whole misunderstanding was because of that?!

Phainon was not going to slip past his fingers ever again. Not when he had finally found the bastard again.

He had been through quite the whirlwind of emotions tonight. Mydei had quite a successful concert. He saw how dumbstruck Phainon looked at his performance too, which filled Mydei with an extreme sense of pride. Then, he felt absolute exhaustion and an absolute longing to be held by said man. Upon returning to his empty hotel room, he had felt absolute shock that shifted into abandonment, which quickly became panic, turning into anger, and now he was at frustration.

Both the flight attendant and the pilot were amazed at how much emotion the rockstar was showing in the span of a single day. Mydei was known to be very grounded and rational, and that hadn't changed throughout the years they had worked for him. It was why he made such a good leader for the band and why the band relied on him as their anchor. And yet, they had watched this man's fuse snap at least twice in one day. All because of the exact same man.

At the first slight beat of his ringtone, Mydei slammed the answer button.

“Krateros?!”

“Why the Hell did you call me 33 times?” Understandably, Krateros was half-awake at 2 AM.

Mydei was really trying his hardest to sound calm over the phone, which wasn't really working at all. “Phainon isn't in his hotel room. Do you have his number?”

“He didn't tell you where he went?”

Mydei was going to explode. Why was he asking him questions instead of just doing what Mydei asked for?! “I haven't seen him since the concert when I was performing, so hurry up and give me his fucking number,” he snapped.

The manager didn't seem the least affected by his harsh words. “Okay, give me a second.”

The call hung up, but Mydei was already quite accustomed to how short his phone calls were with his manager. It was actually very appreciated, as neither party wasted time. And soon after the end of the call, he received a very simple message consisting only of numbers.

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Phainon
chapters.html:
Who was calling him in the middle of the night?

Phainon had paused in his nighttime stroll, staring inquisitively down at his phone that had been ringing for quite a while. Considering that it was the middle of the night, he had assumed it was a spam call and let it ring until the end. But now that the same mysterious number was calling him again, Phainon figured that it was either a very persistent spam caller or he should probably answer this phone call.

Hesitantly pressing the answer button, he raised the receiver to his ear, but he couldn't even get a single word out as the other person at the other end of the line had beaten him to it.

“HKS.”

Phainon's eyes widened at the familiar, deep voice, and his heart began to pound in his chest despite the menacing tone and the menacing word. His voice was definitely the last voice that he was expecting on the other end, especially since he knew he didn't have his number.

He hesitantly opened his mouth, as he was unsure if his ears were working properly. “Mydei?”

“Get your ass back to the hotel. Now.”

The call hung up just as abruptly as it started, with Phainon being left in a confused and silent daze all by himself in the middle of a random city. Did he actually hear Mydei on the other end, or was it just so late into the night that he just completely hallucinated Mydei’s voice? There was no way that was actually Mydei; wasn't he still taking care of work at the concert venue? He wouldn't return that quickly, right?

The phone screen flashed in his face once more as Phainon checked the time to confirm, and holy shit it was 2 AM?! First of all, how did Mydei even call him in the first place? Did Mydei just have Phainon's phone number this entire time?

Whirling his head around at the nearby buildings, Phainon had no clue as to where he was in the city. His feet had ventured all by themselves as Phainon had sunk deep into his thoughts, and he didn't even realize where he had ended up and how long he had been out until that phone call awoke him from his stupor.

He had to actually pull out a navigation application on his phone to travel back to the hotel, as Phainon had no idea where he was. It was about a thirty-minute walk back to the hotel, so Phainon really did go on quite the adventure by himself. And now he had to face the wrath of a certain golden-haired man.

Phainon didn't originally plan on staying out so late, but his deprecating thoughts and depressing emotions just didn't go away, no matter how long Phainon had tried to clear his head. Although his head did feel slightly better, his chest didn't improve at all. Even though he hurried back to the hotel to not worry Mydei, he also wasn't sure what he was going to say to the man once he saw him again.

Happy thoughts, Phainon. Happy thoughts.

He had exactly thirty minutes now to rehearse the lines in his head. He had exactly thirty minutes now to rehearse his smile, his laugh, and his hug to Mydei.

“The concert was great, Mydei!”

“Mydei, you were amazing up there!”

“You were so cool, Mydei!”

Phainon continued with these thoughts over and over in his head as he followed the directions back to the hotel. He was going to forget that last song ever existed and just focus on the feelings and emotions he felt right before the concert ended. He was going to remember everything else that he saw and heard, and he was going to praise Mydei to the moon for it. He was going to be a good and supportive boyfriend for Mydei, and tomorrow, he would help out wherever he could with his dress rehearsal and sound check. Then, they could have their rest day, and Phainon will no longer worry about Mydei's first love anymore.

Mydei's first love… The person Mydei first smiled so sweetly at. The person Mydei had first wrapped his arms around. Phainon took a deep breath, his throat tightening once more. In a few days time, Phainon would forget about him. Phainon would forget about him.

Phainon would forget about him.

He only had to live like this for another few days! Phainon could do it, right? He could act as the perfect and supportive boyfriend for Mydei, right? Right? He just needed to put a huge grin on his face and continually compliment his boyfriend. He just needed to let him know how amazing and jaw-dropping he was on stage. Which were all true, by the way. That last song never changed how Phainon felt about Mydei’s performance, but it just changed how Phainon acted around the man.

The luxury hotel was finally in view, and Phainon crossed the street and was about to enter the lobby. Until he saw the figure of a very well-built man sitting outside and waiting for him.

“Mydei!” Ignoring his clenching heart at seeing the color gold again, he rushed over and immediately draped his coat around the man's broad shoulders. Despite how much he didn't want to talk to him, Phainon's instincts overpowered those feelings. It was cold outside! Why was he just waiting out here instead of in the lobby?

The man glanced up from his feet with an unreadable expression in his eyes. Contrary to the menacing tone he had used over the phone with Phainon, he didn't seem as furious as Phainon had expected. But Phainon wasn't about to be fooled just yet, and he silently waited for whatever judgment or reprimand Mydei was about to give him.

He held out his hand with his palm facing upward. “Give me your phone.”

“Huh?”

“Unlock your phone and give it to me.”

Phainon quickly swiped the phone open for him, handing it over to Mydei, whose face was immediately illuminated by the phone screen. He seemed to be clicking through things on his phone that Phainon couldn't see, but when the phone was handed back to him, it was displaying a new contact in his phone.

“That's my number. Save it this time.” Pushing himself up from the planter's edge, he strolled through the opened glass doors and into the fancy hotel lobby. Phainon, who was still in a daze over Mydei's lack of anger, quickly scurried after him through the doors until they silently arrived at Room 550 once more. It was an ominous silence the entire way up the elevator and through the corridor, with Phainon continually fidgeting to himself while bracing himself for Mydei's scolding voice. It seemed that all his worries of not wanting to see the golden-haired man vanished away and were replaced with guilt over staying out so late without a single word.

The heavy hotel door slammed shut behind him, with Phainon having to stop himself from jumping at the sound that was somehow louder than Mydei's anger. Was Mydei angry? He had to be; this silence could only mean that Mydei was so furious that he couldn't even bring himself to say anything.

“What were you doing out there?” With his back facing Phainon, Mydei's voice was unwavering, yet unsettling still.

“Just… enjoying the sights.” A rehearsed smile graced Phainon's lips. “You were amazing out there, My–”

“Drop it.”

Phainon immediately shut his mouth, with his smile also faltering.

With a heavy sigh, the man pivoted on his feet to face Phainon, who was still fidgeting in front of the room door. “I don't want to hear that right now. I want to hear why you were out there.”

“I really was just enjoying–”

“Don't lie to me, Phainon. I'm not in the mood right now.”

Under his cracking mask, Phainon was beginning to understand what emotions were swirling in Mydei's heart. Anger and exasperation were self-explanatory, but why did his gorgeous golden eyes look so guilty?

With two heavy steps forward, Phainon reached for Mydei's freezing cold hands. He shouldn't have waited so long for Phainon outside. With him being at least thirty minutes away, was Mydei just going to wait out there the entire time until he returned? Was he out there since the call ended, or was he out there even before the call started?

“We should go to sleep.” A small smile was offered in Mydei's way. “It's late, and you have to get up early tomorrow too.”

“Why were you out there?”

“We can talk about that later, okay?” Phainon's perfect smile graced his lips. “If you're too tired to hear me out now, then we can do it another day.”

He tried to tug on the man's hands, but his cold fingertips did not budge.

“Why were you out there, Phainon?”

“Let's go to sleep, okay?”

“Tell me.”

Phainon's chest throbbed at his cracking voice, but he couldn't understand why Mydei was feeling this way right now. Shouldn't Phainon be the one feeling that way? Mydei didn't do anything wrong at all.

His perfect smile didn't falter this time. “Why do you sound like you're about to cry, Mydei?” A weak laugh as Phainon's cold hands caressed a soft cheek. “Shouldn't I be the sad one and apologizing for staying out so late?”

Shattered gold shakily locked with Phainon's blue eyes, and Phainon almost broke himself. He wanted to wrap this beautiful man into his arms, whisper sweet praises into his ear, and have him fall asleep in his arms. Wasn't he tired after the concert? Why was Mydei stubbornly refusing to return to bed now that Phainon had returned?

“Why are you lying to me?” Mydei's breath was trembling as if the cold had suddenly seared its way into his skin. “What did I do?”

“You didn't do anything!” Phainon's eyes widened at the completely false statement. His heart dropped into his stomach at how broken the man looked before him. Why were his beautiful lips quivering like that? Mydei didn't deserve these feelings and emotions at all. Why was he the one feeling guilty when it was all Phainon's fault?

It was all Phainon's fault.

“Then why are you lying to me?”

“I'm really not lying, Mydei, I was really just–”

“Drop it, Phainon.” The shivering man in front of him swallowed thickly, and Phainon wrapped his coat tighter around his shaking frame. “If you say one more time that you were just enjoying the sights, I'm going to fire you.”

“I really was just…”

Under the threatening glare that pierced into his soul, Phainon did not finish the rest of his lie.

Another ominous silence settled upon the two men, with neither one of them willing to back down in the face of the other. Mydei was not going to return to bed without an answer, and Phainon stubbornly refused to grant him the truth.

“It's… really my fault, Mydei.” His perfect boyfriend smile returned. “So, can we please return to bed? You have an early day tomorrow.”

Mydei's eyes flickered over Phainon's face, as if trying to discern if he had uttered the truth or a lie. “What did you do?”

“I…” Phainon's voice wavered. How was he supposed to explain his complicated thoughts in the first place? Where could he even possibly start? “Don't you need to get some sleep for tomorrow? I can tell you all about it after you wrap up your last concert for this city.”

“Phainon.” Mydei clicked his tongue. “I'm going to keep worrying about it for the entirety of tomorrow if you don't tell me. If you're trying to spare me the truth by waiting until after I'm done to tell me, I'm only going to waste all my time thinking about what I've done.”

“You didn't do anything!” Phainon repeated exasperatedly, locking his fingers with Mydei's once more. “You're… so cold. Please, let's just go to bed.” His eyes scanned Mydei's appearance, and it was then that he realized he could still see remnants of makeup around his sharp eyes, and his golden hair was in disarray. “Did you even take a shower? Why don't you take a warm shower first?”

The rockstar's glare only grew. “Phainon, just tell me, or I'm going to cancel tomorrow’s concert.”

“Wha–” Phainon's heart froze. “What?! You… You wouldn't do that.” He internally shook his head. This threat wasn't going to work on Phainon; he knew how much Mydei cared about his work, and he wouldn't disappoint himself, his staff, or his fans by canceling a scheduled concert date literally the night before.
